history.world-divided-judgement.0054.all: Partly agree. Vietnam escalation (1965-) diverted US/USSR attention and made Moscow cost-exposed (arms to N. Vietnam); but thaw also driven by Cuba 1962 fear (hotline 1963, Test Ban 1963), Sino-Soviet split pushing USSR towards West, Brezhnev/Nixon and Ostpolitik. Cuba-era fear and China more important; Vietnam mixed (delayed thaw as much as helped).

history.world-divided-judgement.0005.all: Partly agree. Atomic bomb (Trinity July 1945, Potsdam, Truman tough, secrecy, Hiroshima) bred Soviet suspicion; but ideological differences, Poland/Eastern Europe, Yalta disputes, Roosevelt's death/Truman, Stalin's security demands were deeper causes. Bomb an aggravator not the main cause.

history.world-divided-judgement.0032.all: Partly agree. Rakosi's harsh rule (AVH, show trials, collectivisation, Mindszenty, poor economy) created grievances; but de-Stalinisation (Secret Speech Feb 1956), Poznan riots, Nagy's reforms and removal, Polish October, student demands, Warsaw Pact withdrawal, Suez distraction were also vital. Rakosi long-term underlying cause; de-Stalinisation trigger.

history.world-divided-judgement.0015.all: Partly agree. Truman Doctrine (Mar 1947) containment, Greece/Turkey, ideological line drawn, Cominform response; but Marshall Plan (June 1947, ~$13bn), Berlin blockade/airlift, Czech coup 1948, Bizonia/Deutschmark, NATO 1949 also major. Doctrine foundation but Marshall Plan/Berlin equally or more concrete.

history.world-divided-judgement.0014.all: Partly agree. Soviet expansion (Poland, Romania, Hungary, Czechoslovakia 1948, Iron Curtain, Cominform, Berlin blockade) alarmed West; but Truman Doctrine, Marshall Plan, Bizonia/currency, atomic diplomacy, US-perceived provocation matter. Expansion main but interacts with US response.

history.world-divided-judgement.0003.all: Partly agree. Stalin's security demands (buffer states, Poland, reparations, memory of 1941 invasion) clashed with Allies; but Truman's hostility, Yalta/Potsdam disputes, atomic bomb, ideology, Roosevelt's death also. Security a main cause with Truman's attitude close second.
